approved_scope: Uploaded execution brief: revenue-first product prototype plus bounded S0/S1/S2 research. No sale, outreach, payment setup, funded wallet, signed transaction or paid service authorized.

product_design.choice: Original standard-library file-only CLI producing JSON and self-contained bilingual printable HTML; optional PDF rendering is a delivery step, not runtime dependency. No SaaS, customer database or broker integration.
alternatives_deferred: Host a multi-user SaaS before demand is known
Repackage generic statistics as a certified security/strategy audit
product_design.input_contract: One explicitly declared quote-unit account; bounded trades.csv with completed long-only cycles and daily_equity.csv with every UTCday; config.json declares evidence class, initial capital and final unrealized value. Cash flows at period end, incremental nontrade costs explicit. Reject duplicate IDs, nonfinite numbers, chronology errors, missing days and failed endpoint reconciliation. Partial fills/shorts/multicurrency/rawcustomerstrategyexecution are out of scope.
product_design.honesty: A CSV cannot establish absence of lookahead, overfitting, manipulated history or smart-contract risk. Output UNKNOWN_NOT_TESTED for those. Net PnL, flows, unrealized and extra costs remain separate. Input checks are not an audit certificate.
product_design.security: No eval/pickle/YAML execution, no arbitraryfetch, no embeddeduserHTML; HTMLescaped. Bound input size/rowcount, refuse existingoutputdirectory, no clientdata inGit, no wallet keys. Produce syntheticdemo only as synthetic; allowedresearch sample separately labeled historicalsimulation.
product_design.acceptance: Known-value accounting/TWR/drawdown tests, missingdata/NaN/flow/exposure/zeroNAV/XSS/path tests, exactJSON reexecution and visualFA/EN report review. Revenue evidence starts atzero within this project increment; customerdata requires consent and a retentionplan.

implementation_plan: Read actualbranch/PR15/Issues6and10 and continuity; record existing-versus-new scope.
Research primarycompetitor price/features; distinguish sellerclaims from demand. Prepare draft interviews/outreach only.
Observe failingtests then implement bounded fileanalysis and bilingualreport. Do not widen scope to wallets or execute uploadedcustomer code.
Implement fixed costscreen and trend comparison with correctedATRengine in AGPLexperiment, not by relicensing oldcode.
Run prescribed known-data diagnostics, classify exactcost/liquidity and pristineholdout asPENDING where unavailable.
Deliver samplefiles, docs, unit economics and revenueevidence, then verify publishedsource/tests/output. Do not claim CI until actual result read.
